free_tier.stated: no free tier: a persistent screen is USD 20 a month at the founding price, USD 25 list, and a disposable screen is USD 0.035 an hour from prepaid credit starting at USD 10; USD 5 of credit for disposable screens is given when a card is added
free_tier.notes: The USD 5 card credit is a one-time card-gated amount, not a standing free tier.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a VM with a disk, not an object; each screen has a 50 GB disk
per_object_cap.notes: Snapshots are 3 per screen, up to 50 GB of changes.

retention.stated: a persistent screen runs until stopped or deleted and keeps its disk when stopped; a stopped disposable screen is deleted after 7 days unless started again; each call and its screenshot are kept for 30 days

egress.terms: all screen traffic leaves through the user's own proxy; if it fails the screen goes offline instead of using the Kubi network; no egress price or allowance is published on the pages read

interface_detail: An API, a TypeScript SDK and a hosted MCP server; screen control by pixels or accessibility tree, root and Tailscale SSH, and a live dashboard view
tooling: a hosted MCP server for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, a TypeScript SDK and a plain HTTP and JSON API; bring your own model
chaining: a hosted Linux cloud desktop for computer-use agents, with the browser logins and open apps kept between sessions; it runs on a private VM with its own proxy

limits.value: a disposable screen bills USD 0.035 an hour by the minute from prepaid credit, USD 0.003 an hour stopped, with a USD 10 minimum top-up
a persistent screen is USD 20 a month running or stopped at the founding price, USD 25 list, with one subscription per organization and a screen cap per organization
each screen has 4 vCPU, 8 GB of memory and a 50 GB disk; 5 templates per organization and 3 snapshots per screen

limits_note: Private beta with early access sign-up and no waitlist or approval; no Windows, macOS or GPU; AI models are not included.
binding_note: The USD 20 monthly subscription price, or the USD 10 prepaid credit minimum for a disposable screen, is what a reader must pay before any sandbox time is available.

identity_cost.detail: the hosted sign-up page offers Google, GitHub, passkey or email magic-link sign-in; the vendor states there is no waitlist and no approval at sign-up. A card is required for the USD 5 disposable-screen credit and for a persistent subscription through Stripe; no phone number or ID document is stated

reliability_note: a persistent screen has no idle timeout and keeps its disk when stopped; a failed proxy leaves the screen with no internet; all traffic is recorded for 30 days
confidence_note: the vendor's home and pricing pages were read on 2026-11-25; the sign-in methods are from the hosted console's own sign-in JavaScript, and the free-tier statement from the pricing FAQ
